intent: Keep user-visible QuickPilot features working while bounding Firebase storage, reads, writes, function fan-out, and mobile-data use.

truth_data.deletion_rule: Never delete, merge, hide, or rewrite these paths to solve traffic, duplication, display, or settlement defects.

compact_product_data.read_rule: Read the exact UID and date summary first. Raw fallback is allowed only when the summary is absent and must create or repair the summary once.

bounded_raw_data.deletion_precondition: A verified daily_drive summary exists for the same UID/date and a sampled restore check has passed.
Keep named state-transition evidence; routine screen, toast, and heartbeat events may expire.
Preserve the latest unresolved crash signature and its first/last occurrence summary.
Preserve compact geo cache and miss summaries needed by the address feature.
Preserve compact geo cache and miss summaries needed by the address feature.

legacy_cleanup_rule: Existing raw data is not an automatic deletion target. Cleanup requires a path allow-list, backup with SHA-256, dry-run counts, explicit director approval, deletion readback, and a restore sample.

read_contract.client: Exact UID/date/representative ID or shallow date keys only. No full-history body download, RTDB root scan, or reconnect bootstrap replay.
read_contract.scheduled_functions: Incremental summary/index reads for one exact date only. No all-user all-history raw read in a scheduled function.
read_contract.manual_maintenance: An expensive historical read must be a separately authorized manual job with explicit date/UID bounds, dry-run estimate, concurrency limit, and byte budget.

automatic_stop_signals: Any denied order write after the protected client is installed
Any order request during a BLOCKED quiet window
Any semantic no-op that reaches a database operation
More than one client order transaction or one function invocation for one semantic order change
Any historical BLOCKED_PERMISSION backlog becoming sendable from a new permit
Any canary byte budget breach or accelerating one-minute request rate
stop_action: Publish a newer-generation BLOCKED order_sync_control first, preserve evidence, and diagnose afterward. Do not disable unrelated login, read, social, Hosting, or update services.
